maddeler.e:
تلجوا (form I)
# تَلَجُّوا (talajjū) /ta.lad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَجَّ (lajja)
# تَلِجُّوا (talijjū) /ta.lid͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَجَّ (lajja)
# تُلَجُّوا (tulajjū) /tu.lad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of لَجَّ (lajja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
